extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: modern car dashboard module, 1.5 m wide, approx. 0.95 m deep incl. steering wheel, 0.6 m high
extras.notes: driver side faces -Y (as seen from the seats), left-hand drive; steering wheel (car-dashboard_steering_wheel) is a separate object with its origin in the hub, rotate around its column axis; screens, cluster and ambient strip are emissive with abstract shapes only; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
